judge_input.description:
This change fixes the EOF lookups for `InverseLocation`. As things currently stand, this is something that will panic, and the reason it panics is that any `LineOffset` at all requires there to be a trailing newline present. What we now do instead is use the EOF itself to serve as the end of line for the very last line.

Fixes https://github.com/bufbuild/vscode-buf/issues/478#issuecomment-3541151881
judge_input.title: Fix InverseLocation for EOF lookups
